caption: Fig. 1: Distributed tracing (§2.2). A request (solid black line) tra- verses system processes, depositing trace data that is eagerly ingested into the trace collector backends. End-to-end trace objects are con- structed from trace data, processed, and stored in a database.
subject: how a typical (eager) distributed tracing framework tags, propagates, and immediately reports one request's trace data

groups.why_chosen: A typical tracing framework tags a request once but then reports every span it generates immediately and unconditionally to the backend, win or lose, before it is even known whether the trace will matter.
groups.what_to_learn: A bold wavy line as the request's own path; circled numbers along it; a second, dotted channel and a grey band for the backend — all at 333 px wide
